convention: Mandala modes are lenses (CREW_MODES / CECP_ACTOR_MODES / SOFTWARE_CREATION_MODES), not agents. 1000 ModeKeys = 20 crew × 10 actor × 5 stance. Native named roster remains 60 (20+10+30 SC). Formula unchanged for the 100-agent roster (shared registry, not 100×1000 files).

selection.precedence: role bans > Constitution > Evidence > Profile > Mode
selection.materialize: On demand via scripts/mandala-crew/materialize-mode.mjs — do not dump 100×1000 files
selection.autoApplyApproximation: Invoke brief embeds ModeKey + lens block; Cursor rule mandala-modekey-auto-apply.mdc asks agents to apply it. Not runtime-enforced.
